why: rc27: game terms marked, sting wording

args.notes:
WoWFA Forever 1.0.0-rc27 (test build, built by wowfa2 CI).

Fix: game terms in the spell and talent texts that stood as plain Persian (physical damage, fire damage, shadow damage, spell damage, mana cost, critical strike, spell, health, mana, curse, blessing, totem and more: 383 places) are marked now: they follow the terms switch and take the term colour. The ordinary verbs (increases, reduces, causes) stay plain on purpose.
Fix: the Serpent Sting text (and the other two stings and the warlock curse) now says plainly that each hunter / warlock keeps one sting / curse on a target.
Includes rc7 to rc26.
